process_copy.heading: Mint the ebook NFT
process_copy.body: Buy your ebook NFT for $15 USD. The mint number you receive becomes your referral code.

process_copy.heading: Earn Through Referrals
process_copy.body: Share either your mint number or your link. Whenever someone mints with it, you immediately earn $5 USD. There are no limits and no expiration. If no code is provided, the $5 and ticket are awarded to a random existing ticket holder.

process_copy.heading: Build Up Tickets
process_copy.body: Every completed referral awards one on-chain ticket for the active $500 drawing, tied to the NFT and wallet. More referrals mean more chances to win.

process_copy.heading: Enter the Prize Draws
process_copy.body: $500 is awarded every 100 sales. One affiliate from that 100-sales block is selected through Chainlink VRF for provably fair randomness.

process_copy.heading: Receive Your Rewards
process_copy.body: Commissions are delivered automatically on-chain. Prize winners are posted on the Winners page and collect $500 through the conditional claim button shown during the applicable claim period, with dashboard and email notifications when available.

key_features_copy: Automatic Commissions and Prize Claims: Smart contracts issue commissions instantly, while prize winners collect $500 through the conditional claim button shown during the applicable claim period.
Fair Prize Selection: Chainlink VRF provides genuine randomness.
Gamification: Badges and leaderboards keep the experience fun and competitive.
Transparency: Every transaction and rule is on-chain and verifiable.
Low Fees: Base provides speed with minimal transaction costs.

decisions.reason: Winner email notifications and guidance remain required; the candidate state does not assert that prize payout is automatic.
The claim-flow decision does not alter the Small Block draw amount, cadence, eligibility, qualifying sales, recurrence, or pool funding.
The decision affects collection of a winning prize, not ticket issuance, weighting, eligibility, expiration, or accounting.
A provisioned wallet can still hold a claimed prize, so the wallet creation, custody, access, and holding requirements remain valid unchanged.
The source concerns collection of a drawn prize and does not change mint-confirmation timing, token IDs, or referral and no-referral success messages.
The Transak payment, conversion, wallet, and automatic mint flow are independent of the later prize-winner claim interaction.
The claim-flow decision does not change how prize tickets are counted or displayed in the dashboard, leaderboard, or NFT attributes.
The hero requirement addresses layout and promotional prominence and contains no prize-payout statement that must change.
